scope: Five reviewed GCP control IDs and five metadata defect families, local-only runtime repair with bounded native/legacy validation.

fixes.changed: Project v2 secret/version and legacy v1 name/key independently. Drop all raw literal values and unknown reference payloads, retain structural literal-presence/emptiness booleans and field coverage. Validate nonempty reference fields and supported secret/version syntax before excluding a variable from sensitive-name heuristic. Dual reference kinds or a literal/reference conflict remain UNKNOWN. v1 explicit empty literal is permitted by its API; v2 empty literal still conflicts with its oneof.
fixes.safety: Malformed source/selector/field types and denied reference facts remain UNKNOWN; nonsensitive names cannot bypass invalid references. Literal credential names remain FAIL and known pointer/noncredential names remain PASS. Idempotent sanitizer preserves the structural distinction across repeated projection.

fixes.changed: Recognize developerConnectEventConfig.pullRequest beside GitHub and RepositoryEventConfig; enforce one coherent source, preserve disabled/push applicability, and use optional() for full-native omitted COMMENTS_DISABLED so denied commentControl cannot bypass guards.
fixes.safety: COMMENTS_ENABLED and external-contributor gate PASS, disabled comments FAIL absent approval, approvalRequired true remains supported PASS; unknown/malformed/denied control/source facts remain UNKNOWN. No collector Cloud Build changes.

fixes.changed: Use existing canonical_target to validate and lowercase ApiTarget.service before universal-service comparison.
fixes.safety: Specific case-insensitive API target still PASS; universal case variants FAIL absent meaningful caller restriction. Raw restrictions retained; invalid DNS target UNKNOWN.

fixes.changed: Parse server allowedIps with ipaddress.ip_network(strict=False) and treat every prefixlen 0 as universal. Preserve existing oneof/typed caller validation and raw native caller evidence.
fixes.safety: Restricted IPv4/IPv6 PASS; universal expanded IPv6 and noncanonical IPv4 /0 FAIL without meaningful API restriction. Explicit valid API OR caller branch remains sufficient, malformed/denied lists remain UNKNOWN. Android native object lists are not stringified.

fixes.changed: Validate identified settings resource and nonempty product, default optional omitted enrollmentLevel to ENROLLMENT_LEVEL_UNSPECIFIED and accept its documented BLOCK_ALL meaning, reject unknown or null enum values.
fixes.safety: Notifications-only remains FAIL, ancestor-only or unread ancestor without local enrollment remains UNKNOWN, denied enrollment/enrolledServices remains UNKNOWN. Explicit product enrollment remains a declaration, not effective support-access authorization.

def meaningful_restrictions(item, index):
    restrictions = get(item, "restrictions", dict)
    targets = list_of_objects(optional(restrictions, "apiTargets", [], list))
    names = [canonical_target(get(target, "service", str)) for target in targets]
    api_restricted = bool(names) and "cloudapis.googleapis.com" not in names and all(names)
    status, caller_evidence = caller_restrictions(item, index)
    if status == "UNKNOWN":
        return status, caller_evidence
    if "serverKeyRestrictions" in restrictions:
        body = get(restrictions, "serverKeyRestrictions", dict)
        allowed = get(body, "allowedIps", list)
        # Preserve native restrictions and their evidence; parse only the IP
        # identity needed to recognize all equivalent universal CIDRs.
        networks = [ip_network(value, strict=False) for value in allowed]
        if any(network.prefixlen == 0 for network in networks):
            status = "FAIL"
    return result(not api_restricted and status != "PASS", restricted_services=names, caller_declaration=caller_evidence,
        semantics="Meaningful API target or caller restriction; object nonemptiness alone is not a security restriction")
